messages.AI assistants such as Claude connect to: AI assistants such as Claude connect to this site over MCP (Model Context Protocol). Tools come from the installed FluxWP plugins (SEO, CRM, Mail, Speed…); Flux AI chat uses the same tools.
messages.An old Flux SEO version is running its o: An old Flux SEO version is running its own MCP server. Update Flux SEO; keys and the setting move here automatically.
messages.The assistant works with the permissions: The assistant works with the permissions of the user who created the key. New content is created as a draft; deleting only moves to trash.
messages.New key (shown only now, copy it):: New key (shown only now, copy it):
messages.If none is selected the key works with a: If none is selected the key works with all of the user's permissions. If some are selected it only sees and runs those tools (e.g. only order_summary for a TV order board).
messages.Name: Name
messages.URL with the key, for places where heade: URL with the key, for places where headers can't be added; don't share it:
messages.On Apache, if you see \"Invalid key\", a: On Apache, if you see "Invalid key", add SetEnvIf Authorization "(.*)" HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=$1 to .htaccess, or use the keyed URL.
messages.AI settings of this plugin. Values are s: AI settings of this plugin. Values are stored in Flux AI and read by the plugin.
messages.When off, the plugin's model requests ar: When off, the plugin's model requests are rejected; its tools are turned off separately on the Tools screen.
messages.This plugin declares no settings with th: This plugin declares no settings with the Flux AI SDK; only on/off and the model can be set.
messages.Tools that plugins offer to AI: the shar: Tools that plugins offer to AI: the shared chat and the MCP server. A tool turned off is unavailable in both; tools that change data ask for approval every time.

messages.Plugins add tools with the Flux AI SDK (: Plugins add tools with the Flux AI SDK (flx_ai_tool) or the flx_mcp_tools / flxai_tools filters. If two plugins register the same name, the first stays on and the other waits turned off; switch with "Use this one". Plugin settings: %s.
messages.AI usage across all plugins: cost, time,: AI usage across all plugins: cost, time, cache and tools.
messages.Where time goes: model/thinking vs tools: Where time goes: model/thinking vs tools
messages.Every model request and tool call: which: Every model request and tool call: which system, for whom, which model, tokens, time and cost. Content is stored with personal data masked.
messages.Cache column: tokens read / written. \"~: Cache column: tokens read / written. "~" is estimated from the price list. Content: last outgoing messages and the incoming reply, shortened; e-mail, phone, IBAN and keys are masked.
messages.Plugins that use Flux AI. A system switc: Plugins that use Flux AI. A system switched off here cannot send AI requests; its own settings stay as they are.
messages.The Model column is the model that syste: The Model column is the model that system uses. Change it under Settings › Per-plugin model. Requests to a disabled system are rejected and show as "Disabled" in the log.
messages.Monthly breakdown, spending limits and p: Monthly breakdown, spending limits and provider credit. Amounts in USD; OpenRouter reports actual cost, Anthropic is computed from the price list.
messages.Press Refresh to see remaining credit. (: Press Refresh to see remaining credit. (Anthropic has no balance API; see console.anthropic.com › Billing.)
messages.Enter keys here once; all FluxWP plugins: Enter keys here once; all FluxWP plugins use this connection.
messages.openrouter.ai › Keys. Hundreds of models: openrouter.ai › Keys. Hundreds of models with one key; actual cost is reported with every request.
messages.console.anthropic.com › API Keys. Claude: console.anthropic.com › API Keys. Claude models are listed with the "claude:" prefix.
messages.Only needed when the key is not tied to: Only needed when the key is not tied to a workspace (if the error asks for "anthropic-workspace-id").
messages.Used when a plugin does not specify its: Used when a plugin does not specify its own model.
Choose a model that supports tools.
messages.A cheap model is enough for automatic ch: A cheap model is enough for automatic chat titles.
messages.Used when the plugin's request names no: Used when the plugin's request names no model; empty means the default.
messages.When the same instructions and tools are: When the same instructions and tools are sent again most of the input cost drops (read 0.1x; write 5 min 1.25x, 1 hour 2x). Plugins can override per request. OpenRouter caching is automatic at the provider.
messages.Show the model's thinking summary in cha: Show the model's thinking summary in chat
messages.Stop requests (plugins switch to their f: Stop requests (plugins switch to their fallback behaviour)
messages.Email the admin at the threshold and whe: Email the admin at the threshold and when reached
messages.Everyone only uses tools their own capab: Everyone only uses tools their own capabilities allow. Individual users can also be given the "flxai_chat" capability.
messages.Users can switch from the panel; the cho: Users can switch from the panel; the choice stays in their browser.
messages.Max messages sent to the model: Max messages sent to the model
messages.E.g. Use a formal tone; always create ne: E.g. Use a formal tone; always create new pages as drafts.
messages.Plugins that generate images and video (: Plugins that generate images and video (Flux Studio etc.) use these keys. In automatic mode the first provider with a key for the model is used; a request that may have been charged is never resent to another provider. The spending limit and Logs apply here too.
messages.The OpenRouter key in Providers is also: The OpenRouter key in Providers is also used for images and video.

messages.Let the model draw tables, cards, diagra: Let the model draw tables, cards, diagrams and charts as visuals (```widget and ```mermaid)
messages.Works with any model. Visuals are drawn: Works with any model. Visuals are drawn in a separate, isolated frame with no external links, forms or access to the site.
messages.Gotenberg: HTML and SVG visuals can be s: Gotenberg: HTML and SVG visuals can be sent as PNG.
messages.Imagick: only SVG visuals can be sent as: Imagick: only SVG visuals can be sent as PNG.
messages.None: channels like WhatsApp get text in: None: channels like WhatsApp get text instead of visuals.
messages.Optional. Channels like WhatsApp and ema: Optional. Channels like WhatsApp and email cannot show HTML; visuals are converted to PNG. Shared hosting has no browser, so HTML visuals are converted by Gotenberg on a Docker server (gotenberg/gotenberg:8).
messages.If Gotenberg is protected with basic aut: If Gotenberg is protected with basic authentication.
messages.Leave empty to keep logs forever. If you: Leave empty to keep logs forever. If you enter days, older logs are deleted once a day.
messages.Also store outgoing/incoming content (sh: Also store outgoing/incoming content (shortened; e-mail, phone, IBAN and keys masked)
Leave empty to keep content forever too.
